# Algo Matrics

> Algo Matrics (algomatrics.in) is a multi-tenant algorithmic trading platform
> for Indian and global markets. Users build, backtest, and deploy automated
> trading strategies across Zerodha Kite, Angel One SmartAPI, Delta Exchange,
> and MetaTrader 5, governed by a hierarchical risk engine with kill switches,
> deterministic paper trading, and real-time P&L over WebSocket.

## Key facts

- Product type: web-based algorithmic / systematic trading platform (SaaS)
- Markets: Indian equities and derivatives (NSE: Nifty, BankNifty), crypto
  derivatives (Delta Exchange), and MT5-connected venues
- Brokers supported: Zerodha Kite Connect, Angel One SmartAPI, Delta Exchange,
  MetaTrader 5 (via VPS agent), built-in paper-trading simulator
- Strategies: first-party (SMA crossover, RSI mean reversion, momentum
  breakout) plus user-uploaded Python strategies (sandboxed, reviewed before
  live use)
- Risk management: pre-trade limits, continuous risk checks, and kill switches
  at platform, account, and strategy scope; fail-closed by default
- Plans: free tier with one paper broker connection and one active strategy;
  paid plans enable live trading
- Contact: hello@algomatrics.in
